summary: Frontend-only validation of Admin Inventario → Incidencias tab. Navigation, data rendering, filters, UI testids and translations all pass. Lifecycle write actions (status transition + sync) fail with HTTP 403 due to backend origin allow-list rejecting the preview's cluster-9 origin — a CORS/allowlist drift rather than a UI bug.

critical.issue: Returns 403 Forbidden. security_middleware logs: 'Blocked cross-origin POST from https://p2p-exchange-hub-2.cluster-9.preview.emergentcf.cloud'. CORS_ORIGINS in /app/backend/.env only lists cluster-3, not cluster-9. All write endpoints affected via this preview URL (incident status transition + sync).
Same 403 cross-origin block from cluster-9 origin. Frontend shows toast 'No se pudo sincronizar'.

integration_issues.flow: Incident status transition (Marcar en revisión / Resolver)
integration_issues.issue: Confirming the inline note fires POST /status which backend rejects with 403; status badge remains 'Pendiente'. Caused by backend CORS allowlist (see backend_issues). The frontend DOES surface a 'Incidencia actualizada' toast optimistically — consider only showing success toast after 2xx response.
POST /incidents/sync returns 403; UI shows red error toast 'No se pudo sincronizar' (good error handling).

action_items: Update backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS to include the current preview cluster origin: https://p2p-exchange-hub-2.cluster-9.preview.emergentcf.cloud (currently only cluster-3 is whitelisted). After update, run sudo supervisorctl restart backend and re-test POST /admin/inventory/incidents/{id}/status + /sync.
(Optional) Make the success toast in InventoryIncidentsTab fire only on 2xx response rather than optimistically — currently 'Incidencia actualizada' shows even when the PATCH fails.
critical_code_review_comments: Success toast on incident status update appears to be optimistic — it fires regardless of API response (observed: toast present while backend returned 403 and status badge did not change).
Origin allowlist drift: CORS_ORIGINS lists cluster-3 but Emergent is now serving the preview from cluster-9; keep this env var in sync with the active ingress origin.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all read + UI render + filters + regression pass; writes blocked by backend 403)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing data: 2 reorder products, 48 open conteo_pendiente incidents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read endpoints work fine (GET reorder=2 products, GET incidents=48 open). Only writes blocked. Verified pass: inventory-tab-incidents, inventory-incidents-view, inventory-reorder-panel, reorder-summary (2/0/5/5), reorder-table (2 rows: Aceite Vegetal +4, Test Product iter205 +1), reorder-refresh-btn, incidents-summary (48/48/0/0), incidents-list (48 rows), incidents-filter-status filter (Resuelta→empty state visible, Pendiente→48), incidents-filter-type options correct, incident-review-{id} reveals incident-note-{id} + incident-confirm-{id}, Control tab regression (Spanish headers Producto/Existencia/Mín./Objetivo/..., 48 inventory-target-input-{id} + 48 inventory-min-input-{id}), zero i18n key leaks. After CORS fix, re-test status transition + sync lifecycle.
rca of the issue: Playwright → emergent infra reroutes/sets Origin to https://p2p-exchange-hub-2.cluster-9.preview.emergentcf.cloud on write requests. backend/.env CORS_ORIGINS whitelist contains cluster-3 but not cluster-9, so OriginAllowlistMiddleware (security_middleware.py) returns 403 for POST. Fix: add cluster-9 origin to CORS_ORIGINS (and ideally cover both). Reproduction: with provided cookie, click Incidencias tab → Marcar en revisión on any incident → confirm. Observe backend log 'Blocked cross-origin POST from ...cluster-9...' and UI status stays Pendiente.
